realMachineTests.transcript: node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --format=text returned PASS for T1/T2/T3 with candidate counts 10,000/100,000/1,000,000, MemoryScore=100.00, exactRecall@1=1.000, recall@10=1.000, MRR@10=1.000, precision@10=1.000, hardFails=0, and the explicit non-authority note.
node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=50000 --format=json failed with unsupported candidateCounts=50000; supported fixed-tier candidate counts are 10000, 100000, 1000000.

Direct dist runtime probes with runMemoryBenchmark({tier:"T1",baselineQualityScore:90,overrides}) showed exactRecallAt1=0.9, recallAt10=0.89, mrrAt10=0.74, and precisionAt10=0.69 each return verdict FAIL and thresholdPassed=false even while MemoryScore remains above the tier threshold.

npm --prefix packages/main run test:memory-benchmark-smoke passed, covering deterministic signatures, fixed-tier compare semantics, unsupported-count rejection, hard-fail precedence, and per-metric minima regressions.
